metadata.evaluation_phase: Final Evaluation Freeze — One-Time Held-Out Test & Challenge

methodology_notes.one_time_freeze: Held-out test and challenge partitions evaluated strictly once. No retuning performed.
methodology_notes.production_pipeline_enforced: All predictions generated via official scorePair.js and classifyScoreByThresholds.
methodology_notes.parity_audit_notice: Simplex fastEval discrepancy identified and bypassed; official scorePair pipeline used exclusively.

HISC.name: HISC (Hierarchical Incident Stream Clustering)
HISC.formula: Weighted multi-attribute affinity: S = 0.20*Cat + 0.25*Geo + 0.10*Lex + 0.30*Sem + 0.15*Time with contextual classification rules.

B1_jaccard.name: B1: Text Jaccard Similarity
B1_jaccard.formula: S = |Tokens_A ∩ Tokens_B| / |Tokens_A ∪ Tokens_B| on normalized alphanumeric word tokens.

B2_distance.name: B2: Distance-Only Similarity
B2_distance.formula: S = exp(-d / 1000) where d is Haversine distance in meters.

B3_cat_distance.name: B3: Category Plus Distance
B3_cat_distance.formula: S = 0.5 * CategoryScore(cat_A, cat_B) + 0.5 * exp(-d / 1000). Equal 50/50 convex weighting.

B4_tfidf.name: B4: TF-IDF Cosine Similarity
B4_tfidf.formula: S = Cosine(v_A, v_B) with smoothed IDF fitted strictly on TRAIN texts (97 vocabulary terms).

B6_embedding.name: B6: Embedding Cosine Similarity Only
B6_embedding.formula: S = Cosine(e_A, e_B) using Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 384-dim normalized mean-pooled vectors.

HISC_embed.name: HISC-embed (Embedding-Backed Semantic Affinity)
HISC_embed.formula: Weighted multi-attribute affinity: S = 0.20*Cat + 0.25*Geo + 0.10*Lex + 0.30*S_embed + 0.15*Time with contextual rules.

HISC_hybrid_mean.name: HISC-hybrid-mean (Mean of Dictionary & Embedding)
HISC_hybrid_mean.formula: S_sem = 0.5 * S_dictionary + 0.5 * S_embedding in HISC multi-attribute scorer.

HISC_hybrid_max.name: HISC-hybrid-max (Maximum of Dictionary & Embedding)
HISC_hybrid_max.formula: S_sem = max(S_dictionary, S_embedding) in HISC multi-attribute scorer.

HISC_learned_weights.name: HISC-learned-weights (Train-Learned Simplex Weights)
HISC_learned_weights.formula: Learned simplex weights: S = 0.00*Cat + 0.30*Geo + 0.00*Lex + 0.40*Sem + 0.30*Time. Retains hand-set baseline in production.
